combination.rule: arithmetic mean of the members' raw option probabilities per case, then the temperature transform softmax(log p_mean / T)
combination.cost: two forward passes per case (~2x single-model inference, ~520M total)

temperature.fitted_on: ensemble cal_temperature (3,150 synthetic calibration cases), E42 NLL grid + ternary refinement

abstention.rule: smallest grid value whose ensemble cal_policy CP95 UPPER bound of selective risk <= 0.05 (the grid bottom already qualifies: the ensemble is sharper than the single model)

bounds: same protocol- and distribution-specific guarantees as the single model (synthetic families); real-image abstention remains not validated - E51 Arm B measured the screens-domain gate NOT claimable for the ensemble either (budget met only at 24% coverage, below the pre-registered 30% floor)
input_rule: upscale the image (Lanczos) so its longest side is 1,024 px when smaller, then process with max_side 1,024 (E46); build_batch(..., max_side=1024, upscale_to=1024), identical for both members
deployment_note: the hosted demo runs the single s43 policy (tau 0.55); the Amber Checkpoint in-game audit is bound to that policy and is not re-validated under the ensemble
